Theme

Computing & programming

record verb

sound or video

also make a recording, record a song, record yourself, tape, make a tape

modern

M-O s.v. record, tape vb.

sonī imāginem excipiō, excipere, excēpī, exceptum

record sound

A modern description, literally “to catch the likeness of the sound”; for a voice, vōcis imāginem. Excipere classically is “catch, take up, receive”.

Other words

  • imprimō, imprimere, impressī, impressum — record (on a tape or disc)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · modern · M-O s.v. record, tape vb. (Egger); Traupman 53

    Classically “press into, imprint”; used in the modern sense by Egger, of a voice pressed into a cassette.

Examples

  • in phōnotaeniolā imprimere

    to tape (record on tape)Traupman 390

  • phōnotaeniolam cōnficere

    to make a tapeTraupman 390

See also record, song.

SourcesLewis & Short: excipio · Lewis & Short: imago · Lewis & Short: imprimo
